name: nobleseo
description: NobleSEO base workflows: keyword clusters, research and briefs, GSC, supported article generation and Refresh, draft review and existing assets.

interface.shortDescription: NobleSEO research, articles and GSC workflows
interface.longDescription: Use discovered NobleSEO MCP base workflows for keyword clusters, research, briefs, GSC, supported single-article generation and Refresh, draft review and existing assets. Installing the plugin does not deploy server tools or extend permissions. Factory, WordPress and Google Analytics are outside this release.
defaultPrompt: Use $keyword-clustering to review my existing run and export a keyword map.
Use $seo-content-briefing to create a local brief from existing research.
Use $gsc-performance-review to diagnose changes in these GSC exports.
Use $gsc-visualization to chart daily clicks from my GSC export.
